name: mcp-openstack-ops
description: Operate and monitor an OpenStack cloud with one fixed OpenStack account.
long_description: Runs the MCP-OpenStack-Ops server locally over stdio. Claude Desktop installs Python and the locked dependencies with uv. Modify tools stay disabled unless 'Allow modify operations' is enabled.

os_auth_host.title: Keystone host (OS_AUTH_HOST)
os_auth_host.description: Host name or IP address of the OpenStack Identity (Keystone) API

os_auth_protocol.title: Protocol (OS_AUTH_PROTOCOL)
os_auth_protocol.description: http or https for all OpenStack APIs

os_cacert.title: CA certificate (OS_CACERT, optional)
os_cacert.description: Optional. CA bundle for HTTPS. Without it, HTTPS certificate verification is disabled

os_project_name.title: Project name (OS_PROJECT_NAME)
os_project_name.description: OpenStack project to scope the connection to

os_password.title: Password (OS_PASSWORD)
os_password.description: OpenStack user password, stored securely by Claude Desktop

os_compute_port.title: Nova port (OS_COMPUTE_PORT)
os_compute_port.description: Compute (Nova) API port on the Keystone host

os_network_port.title: Neutron port (OS_NETWORK_PORT)
os_network_port.description: Networking (Neutron) API port on the Keystone host

os_volume_port.title: Cinder port (OS_VOLUME_PORT)
os_volume_port.description: Block Storage (Cinder) API port on the Keystone host

os_image_port.title: Glance port (OS_IMAGE_PORT)
os_image_port.description: Image (Glance) API port on the Keystone host

os_placement_port.title: Placement port (OS_PLACEMENT_PORT)
os_placement_port.description: Placement API port on the Keystone host

os_heat_stack_port.title: Heat port (OS_HEAT_STACK_PORT)
os_heat_stack_port.description: Orchestration (Heat) API port on the Keystone host

os_heat_stack_cfn_port.title: Heat CFN port (OS_HEAT_STACK_CFN_PORT)
os_heat_stack_cfn_port.description: Heat CloudFormation API port on the Keystone host

allow_modify_operations.title: Allow modify operations (ALLOW_MODIFY_OPERATIONS)
allow_modify_operations.description: Register set_* tools that create, change, or delete cloud resources

allow_cross_project_read.title: Allow cross-project reads (ALLOW_CROSS_PROJECT_READ)
allow_cross_project_read.description: Let supported list tools accept all_projects=true; OpenStack policy still decides whether the account may read other projects
